data.name: Bashirah
data.gender_notes: Bashirah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who conveys good news, announces or delivers a message. Derived from the name Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) title, As-Sayyid Al-Ameer Al-Moumineen (The Master of the Faithful). The name Bashirah carries the meaning “Bringer of good news” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Bashirah usually hope their child will grow to embody bringer of good news and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the spread of positive energy, joy and happiness, and the importance of delivering good news to others.
data.etymology: Bashirah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bringer of good news.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bashirah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: بَشِيرَة
in_arabic.long_meaning: شَريفة، مُبارَكَة، تُحَدّث بِالخَير، يُشير إلى مَن يُبَشِّر بِالخَير، وَتَعودُ مِنهُ في قَولِ النَّبيِّ صَلّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِيهِ: "النَّبيُّ بَشيرٌ حَكيمٌ". وَهِيَ مِن أَمثَالِ الاسماءِ الَّتي تُشيرُ إلى الصِفاتِ الَّتي يَضُمُّها الإِنسانُ، وَتُشيرُ في حَيّاتِ الإِنسانِ إلى المَخَرَجِ مِنَ الضَياعِ إِلَيهِ، وَتَدُلُّ على المَنزِلَةِ الَّتي يَستَقيمُ بِها الإِنسانُ

in_urdu.name: بشیرہ
in_urdu.meaning: پاک، خوش گوار، بھلائی کا پیغام
in_urdu.long_meaning: پاک، خوش گوار، بھلائی کا پیغام، جو اپنے آسمان کے ساتھ نیک خبریں لاتا ہے۔ اسلامی روایت کے مطابق، بُشر اُن لوگوں کے لئے ہے جو نیک خبریں لاتے ہیں اور اُن کے لئے ایسے لوگ نیک خبریں لاتے ہیں جن کے ہاتھوں سے نیک خبریں پہنچتی ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: बशीरा
in_hindi.long_meaning: श्रेष्ठ, सौभाग्यशाली, खुशगوار, जो अपने आसमान के साथ सुखद ख़बरें लाता है। इस्लामी परंपरा के अनुसार, बशीरा वह व्यक्ति होता है जो सुखद ख़बरें लाता है और जिसे प्रभु की ख़ुशख़बरी का प्रतीक माना जाता है।

in_english.name: Bashirah
in_english.meaning: Blessed, fortunate, bearer of good tidings, auspicious
in_english.long_meaning: Blessed, fortunate, bearer of good tidings, auspicious, in Islamic tradition, Bashirah refers to one who brings good news, and in Arabic, it is a feminine form of the name Bashir, meaning 'one who brings good news'. It is derived from the root b-sh-r, which means 'to be happy, to rejoice'. In the Quran, there is no direct reference to the name Bashirah, but it is mentioned in hadiths as a term for one who brings good news. In modern times, the name Bashirah is used in many Muslim cultures to signify a person who brings joy, happiness, and prosperity to others.

This title means "The Master of the Faithful," and Bashirah can be seen as a reflection of this title, as the nameholder is one who conveys good news, delivers messages, or announces important information.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Bashirah holds a deeper spiritual significance for Muslims, given its connection to the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). In Islamic tradition, Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) was described as Al-Mughith (The Conquering), a title signifying his ability to bring blessings, peace, and good tidings to humanity. Thus, the name Bashirah can be seen as a reminder of the power of positive communication and the blessings that come from conveying good news.
